method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); two regulative rules (the participant's 28 days to ask for an assessor, s 24(2), and to refer an assessor's determination for review, s 25(2)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts, the two last-day questions taking their deadline from those rules rather than restating it; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

seats: the person who suffered a motor accident injury (or a parent, guardian or other person acting for them), who is or may become a participant in the Lifetime Care and Support Scheme (ltcs-scheme.l4)

the owner or driver of an uninsured motor vehicle whose fault caused a participant's injury, or another person partly at fault, from whom the Authority may recover under s 54 (ltcs-seat-owner-driver.l4)
